Subject: Micro-loop: compact panel sequencing + candidate check-in

Hi team,

We have Jane Doe's virtual full loop on Thursday (candidate confirmed). Recruiter asked for a compact schedule to reduce context switching for evaluators and to provide a short candidate check-in at the top. Proposed constraints: 3x40m interview slots (system design, product/behavior, coding) with two evaluators per slot; 10m pause between slots for notes/quick sync; 10m candidate break at the midpoint.

Requesting:
- Marissa: can you take product/behavior + debrief owner?
- Jonas: can you lead system design and pair with a second evaluator?
- Laura: can you be the shadow/eval backup and run the debrief doc?

I've attached Jane's resume and a draft runbook (microloop_runbook_v1.docx). If everyone confirms availability I will send the calendar blocks and a short prep note to Jane (10m pre-check).

Thanks — Irene

Attachments: jane_doe_resume.pdf (resume, 1 page), microloop_runbook_v1.docx (runbook, includes evaluator rubrics, timing)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Micro-loop: compact panel sequencing + candidate check-in

Sounds good — thanks for the clear plan, Irene. I can own product/behavior and capture the hiring committee notes. A couple of tweaks:

- Move the candidate 10m pre-check to 15m (candidate prefers a slightly longer check-in when loops are compressed).
- Make the middle break 15m instead of 10m so evaluators have time to rate answers and add notes (we'll likely be tight).
- For debrief, let's do a 30m synchronous wrap instead of async. I'll invite the full panel + hiring manager.

Jonas — will you be okay adding a short prompt set for the system-design slot (3 questions, 25m active discussion + 15m whiteboard follow-up)? If so we can keep the 40m slot shape.

If everyone agrees I agree to own the debrief doc and run the 30m sync.

— Marissa
